name: grades_analyze
description: Collect every page for a paper, select the latest record per student and paper using (time, status_id), and compute score distribution, population statistics, group summaries and optional competition ranks. Pass thresholds and full scores must be explicitly supplied. Fails on incomplete pagination; no-record students are not counted as zero. Gateway requests are GET-only to the activation-configured HTTPS origin; it never follows redirects or contacts iaaa.gbu.edu.cn. Browser authentication, including session reuse and any SSO navigation, uses visible Chromium only.
